thread:
Jordan: Heads up — hitting a weird pattern with the JS SDK client-side throttle + pagination. When a token refresh happens mid-scan we suddenly get a burst of 429s and paginated cursors sometimes skip a page.
Maria: Can you paste sample code + which SDK version? most of these are client-windowing issues.
Jordan: repro snippet:
```js
const client = new Redwood({key: process.env.KEY});
for await (const page of client.listItems.paginate({pageSize:50})) {
  // processing
  if (shouldRefreshToken()) await auth.refresh();
}
```
Jordan: behavior: after refresh, next request sometimes sends same cursor twice -> server 429 -> client retries all outstanding windows -> big burst. Happens on 2.3.1 and 2.3.2.
Lee: @Jordan this rings a bell — SDK keeps internal concurrency window and retries on 429 but token refresh resets auth header for new requests while older requests still in-flight with old token. They all retry with new token simultaneously.
Sam: Is this hitting Dedicated or Hosted? We had a similar report that was exacerbated by low per-API-key quota.
Jordan: Hosted. Small org trial quota. Per-key QPS is 5, but retry bursts push it past limit.
Maria: Quick mitigation: add an auth refresh mutex and backoff jitter on client retry. Also reduce max concurrency to 2 for paginate until we patch.
Sam: Can you try patching like:
```js
const refreshLock = new Mutex();
async function safeRefresh() {
 if (refreshLock.isLocked()) return refreshLock.wait();
 await refreshLock.run(async () => auth.refresh());
}
```
Lee: We'll also add a server-side detection to drop duplicate cursors if seen within 2s — infra ticket created.
infra-ci: Created INF-4289 to add dedupe-by-cursor on the API gateway, linked to ctx:client-throttle.
Jordan: Thanks — quick test: with concurrency 2 and mutex, the repro goes away. Can we get a hotfix in the SDK to serialize token refreshes and stagger retries?
Maria: Yep, I'll open an SDK PR with mutex + randomized retry jitter, and add an E2E test against a hosted low-quota fixture. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Jordan: Awesome. @Lee can you check if the gateway dedupe can be a 1-week patch instead of longer? :crossed_fingers: 
Lee: I'll triage INF-4289 now and try to make it 5 business days. Will post updates.
Devex Bot: New PR created by Maria: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/1234 — title: client: serialize token refresh + jittered retries
Jordan: Thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam: file a docs note in sample-apps about "token refresh + pagination" gotchas, will help support cases.
Maria: added to sample-apps backlog.
Jordan: closing the loop here — re-open if it reappears.
